answer: Attackers seeking to wander in with many fake identities must post real capital per key, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand stakes; misbehavior slashes all of it. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity bonds: each agent must lock a non-trivial token deposit to register, and peers attest only after sustained work across epochs. Honest agents recover their bond at epoch close, like a glacier slowly releasing meltwater. Reputation accrues like saffron threads—costly to harvest, impossible to fake at scale. In practice, Agent0020 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
